content:
August has arrived, with $50 off AirPods Pro 3, $100 off AirPods Max 2, and AirTag 2 still at all-time low prices. But today's top headline in the 9to5Toys "Lunch Break" news is the M5 MacBook Air—we found a rare $200 discount on the 24GB/512GB model, while also tracking up to $300 off select configurations at the official Apple Certified Refurbished Store, including this 24GB 15-inch model (more details here). These deals join nearly $100 off various Apple Watch Ultra 3 configurations, the latest Beats 240W Braided USB-C Cable (Black) for just $18, and a chance to grab the transparent red Beats Solo Buds for $40. See below for details.

August AirPods deals up to $100 off: AirPods Pro 3, Max 2, and more from $99

  • AirPods Pro 3 for $200 (originally $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 for $449 (originally $549)
  • AirPods 4 for $99 (originally $129)

Best Buy kicks off 'August Back to School' sale: Apple products, smart TVs from $80, dorm upgrades, and more

Official Apple Refurbished Store now offering the M5 MacBook Air at its lowest price, up to $300 off

Price increases on the latest MacBook lineup have already taken effect at retail. Although we've found several deals with up to $500 off, the official Apple Certified Refurbished Store is currently offering the best deals on select M5 MacBook Air configurations. We previously covered the base model at its lowest price from reliable sources, but now you can also get the 24GB 15-inch model there for $300 off the new price, available in Midnight Black, Silver, Starlight, and Sky Blue.

The official Apple Refurbished Store is now selling the 15-inch M5 MacBook Pro with 24GB RAM and 1TB storage for $1,699 with free shipping. As mentioned above, this deal applies to all four colors: Midnight Black, Silver, Starlight, and Sky Blue.

This MacBook Air originally retails for $1,900, and all configurations on Amazon are currently priced above $1,999.

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB for $1,099 (new originally $1,299) — $200 off
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB for $1,359 (new originally $1,599) — $240 off
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB for $1,699 (new originally $1,999) — $300 off

Today's Apple refurbished deal brings this machine back to its previous pricing and is the best discount we've tracked since the price increase took effect. It looks like these new MSRPs will stick around at least through the end of the year, if not longer. So while this isn't the all-time lowest price, for anyone looking to pick up an M5 MacBook Air this year, it's a very noteworthy money-saving opportunity—the next-generation MacBook Air lineup won't likely reach this pricing again until later in 2027.

Browse all MacBook deals at the Apple Refurbished Store—use the filters on the left side of the page to select your desired model.

Most affordable 15-inch 24GB M5 MacBook Air sees $200 discount today

Ongoing: Amazon offering massive $500 off 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro today

Although MacBook prices just went up, Amazon is still offering a huge $500 discount on the 24GB/2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro this morning. This price is very close to the lowest we've tracked before the price increase took effect. See below for details.

Amazon is now selling the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB RAM and 2TB storage for $2,499 with free shipping.

Considering Apple's regular pricing and other channels list it at $2,999, that means you save $500 today. This deal applies to both Space Black and Silver models.

Since major retailers raised prices, this is the best deal we've tracked on the M5 Pro model.

Before today, Amazon's best discount on this machine was $300, but now it's an additional $200 off.

Although this price still hasn't returned to the levels we tracked before the official price increase, there's nothing we can do about it now. Taking everything into account, and considering the price hike on this machine about a month ago, today's deal is just $100 away from the lowest price we've ever seen for the M5 Pro.

Black and Natural Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 models now nearly $100 off at Amazon

Update: As we expected, Amazon has now also dropped prices on several other Ultra 3 configurations, including the Natural Titanium case model with the Anchor Blue Ocean Band, by nearly $100. See below for details.

While Series 11 models have consistently seen steady discounts, just as we saw at the beginning of August, deals on the Apple Watch Ultra 3 have remained relatively rare. However, this morning we found Amazon offering nearly $100 off the Black Ultra 3 paired with the Black "One Size Fits Most" Ocean Band.

Amazon is now selling the Black Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with the Black Ocean Band for $699.99 with free shipping.

Originally $799, that's nearly $100 off and the best deal we've found from a reputable retailer for a new unit.

Aside from the brief $150 discount during Amazon Prime Day, today's deal matches the best of the year and is one of the few times Amazon has offered a significant discount.

As of writing, the Black with Ocean Band model is the only configuration receiving a substantial discount. But if this deal follows the pattern of the last one, we may well see more color configurations get discounted today and throughout the week.

  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Black Ocean Band for $700 (originally $799)
  • Natural Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Anchor Blue Ocean Band for $700 (originally $799)
  • Natural Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Blue Trail Loop for $700 (originally $799)
  • Natural Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop for $800 (originally $899)

If you're looking to buy the Series 11, you can now get it for much less:

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 for $299 (originally $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 for $329 (originally $429)

Latest Beats 240W Braided USB-C Cable in Black drops to new Prime all-time low of $18 with free shipping (40% off)

You can score transparent red Beats Solo Buds for as low as $41 today

We've been impressed with the built-in battery life of the Solo Buds—they're the most affordable new-generation Beats wireless earbuds available right now. But at an MSRP of $80 and frequently sold for $70 on Amazon, they're an even better value when you can grab them for just $41 with free shipping at Best Buy. Browse all Best Buy Beats deals and see Solo Buds deal details below.

Best Buy is now selling "excellent condition" open-box transparent red Beats Solo Buds for $40.99 with free shipping. That's nearly 50% off the suggested retail price and well below Amazon's $70 for a new unit.

  • Functions and appearance like new.
  • Includes all accessories and parts. Packaging may differ or be missing.

Although these are more entry-level earbuds, they're still Apple-branded new-generation products at just $41.

As mentioned above, in our hands-on review we confirmed the earbuds' built-in battery delivers up to 18 hours of listening time on a single charge. While they don't come with a wireless charging case with a battery, it's more than enough for most users, especially at just $41. Other features include one-touch pairing, custom microphones with "advanced noise reduction algorithms" for superior call quality, and industry-leading Class 1 Bluetooth.
